It’s also about the ritual of dressing up: the way a well-tailored suit makes you stand taller, the attention to detail in the tie, or even the subtle shift in mindset that comes from "dressing for the role you want." Confidence is deeply personal, though—what works for one person might not for another ( some people feel more empowered in casual wear, for instance).
